title: Vitraux
description: Decorative stained glass panes with pre-made patterns and a custom pixel-art editor
body: ![Exemple of what you can do with custom vitraux](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4332f82bb2512376c0d83486e313fd8a0785a569.webp)Bring the beauty of medieval stained glass to Minecraft. Vitraux adds 16 decorative glass panes crafted from glazed terracotta patterns, each with luminance-based transparency and shader-driven colored shadows. For total creative freedom, craft a Glazier's Bench to design your own pixel-art vitraux up to 4×4 blocks, then stamp them onto your world using reusable template items. Full Iris shader support included — no configuration required.
